selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What major project did the king begin after deciding to show his greatness and treasures?
questions.answer: He began building a huge, impressive palace.

questions.question: What can we infer from the king decorating the palace with treasures from his own stores?
questions.answer: It suggests that the palace was meant to reveal what belonged to him and to show his excellence.

questions.question: How does the passage show that the banquet was extremely generous?
questions.answer: It says the meal included many kinds of delicious things and was arranged with great care and richness.

questions.question: How did wisdom and knowledge appear in the palace?
questions.answer: They appeared in the careful order, subtle design, and remarkable crafted details.

questions.question: Why would each group have its own fitting table instead of everyone being treated exactly the same way?
questions.answer: It suggests that the king provided in a way suited to different groups and situations.

questions.question: What did the teacher explain about the artistic works inside the palace?
questions.answer: He explained what they pointed to and how they reflected the owner’s qualities.

questions.question: Besides explaining the palace, what else was the teacher supposed to make known?
questions.answer: He was to describe the maker, explain the secrets of the decorations, and show what the artworks pointed to.

questions.question: Why did the people need to be taught the correct manners for viewing the palace?
questions.answer: Because the king had a desired way for his guests to respond to what they saw.

questions.question: What can we understand from the teacher’s assistants being placed in each part of the palace?
questions.answer: Guidance was meant to reach visitors everywhere in the palace.

questions.question: How does this passage prepare the reader for what comes next?
questions.answer: It sets up the speaker’s announcement by showing why the people need guidance to understand the palace correctly.

questions.question: What does the palace itself show about the king’s intentions?
questions.answer: It shows that he wanted to display his riches, skill, wisdom, and knowledge in a grand way.

questions.question: What two things were especially spread through the palace to impress the guests?
questions.answer: Valuable ornaments and beautifully prepared food.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the king’s own involvement in the palace’s beauty?
questions.answer: It shows that he personally adorned it with skillful works.

questions.question: What does the rich banquet add to the meaning of the palace?
questions.answer: It shows the king’s generosity along with his power and artistry.

questions.question: What hidden aspect of the palace was the teacher supposed to uncover?
questions.answer: He was supposed to uncover the purposes, secrets, and meanings behind what the people saw.

questions.question: What was one main duty of that teacher?
questions.answer: He was to explain the purpose of the palace and the meaning of what was inside it.

questions.question: What connection did the teacher make between the beauty of the palace and the owner?
questions.answer: He showed that the beauty and artistry of the palace pointed to the owner’s perfections and skills.

questions.question: How was the teaching organized across the palace?
questions.answer: The main teacher stayed in the central large room, and helpers served in the other sections.

questions.question: How do the assistants support the teacher’s mission?
questions.answer: They carry the teaching throughout the palace so people in every area can be guided.

questions.question: Where was the teacher himself when he addressed the people?
questions.answer: He was in the largest room among his students, making an announcement to everyone there.

questions.question: In your own words, describe the palace the king built.
questions.answer: It was a large, splendid place with many rooms, rich decorations, and carefully arranged beauty.

questions.question: What kinds of things did the king use to decorate the palace?
questions.answer: He used jewels, beautiful crafted works, and carefully arranged decorations.

questions.question: Who did the king appoint after inviting the people?
questions.answer: He appointed a highest-ranking commander to teach the people.

questions.question: What does the appointment of a supreme commander as teacher show about the importance of the message?
questions.answer: It shows that the message was serious, official, and central to the whole palace.

title: 11 Word Construction of the Palace and Appointment of the Explaining Master
